# nilportugues/cache

> 标签: cache, chainable, delegation, elasticsearch, file, filesystem, memcached, mongo, mongodb, mysql, nil portugues, nilportugues, performance, predis, redis, sphinx, sphinxql, sql, system

## 简介

Cache layer for PHP applications using the on Chain of responsability pattern

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。
